tickerText: [TENNIS] Championship Sunday: Daniil Medvedev faces qualifier Nikoloz Basilashvili in the Almaty final after Medvedev advanced 6-3 when Alexander Bublik retired and Basilashvili upset Stefanos Tsitsipas 6-4, 6-7(5), 6-3; Lorenzo Musetti meets Taylor Fritz in Lyon and Jan-Lennard Struff plays Tallon Griekspoor in Brussels, while Elena Rybakina and Leylah Fernandez clash in the Ningbo WTA 500 final • [SQUASH] Sivasangari Subramaniam captured the PSA Gold Silicon Valley Open, beating Farida Mohamed 11-7, 11-6, 11-8 for her fourth title of 2026; Victor Crouin and Mohamad Zakaria met in the men's final after Crouin rallied past Diego Elias in five and Zakaria swept Mohamed ElShorbagy • [BADMINTON] YONEX French Open finals day at Arena Grand Paris: world No. 1 An Se-young meets resurgent P.V. Sindhu in women's singles, Christo Popov and Moh. Zaki Ubaidillah contest an all-semifinalist men's final after Ubaidillah stunned Alex Lanier, and Feng Yan Zhe/Huang Dong Ping chase a third straight mixed crown • [PICKLEBALL] Hang Seng Bank Hong Kong Slam crowns champions at Kai Tak on Championship Sunday as Judit Castillo faces Andie Dikosavljevic in women's singles and Tama Shimabukuro meets Hunter Johnson in the men's final at the season-ending PPA Asia 1500 • [TABLE TENNIS] ITTF-ATTU Asian Championships medal Sunday in Tashkent: men's and women's singles semifinals pit Li Tianyang vs Kuo Guan-hong and Wen Ruibo vs Tomokazu Harimoto, with doubles finals on Olympic Town courts after Japan's Miwa Harimoto and Sora Matsushima took mixed doubles gold

newsItems.title: Almaty Final Set
newsItems.excerpt: Daniil Medvedev will play Nikoloz Basilashvili for the Almaty Open title after Medvedev led 6-3 when Alexander Bublik retired in the semifinals and Basilashvili upset Stefanos Tsitsipas 6-4, 6-7(5), 6-3.

newsItems.title: French Open Finals Day
newsItems.excerpt: The YONEX French Open closes at Arena Grand Paris with An Se-young facing P.V. Sindhu for the women's crown, Popov and Ubaidillah in the men's final after the Indonesian teen ended Lanier's home run, plus Feng/Huang in mixed doubles.

newsItems.title: Hong Kong Slam Sunday
newsItems.excerpt: Kai Tak Arena hosts Championship Sunday at the Hang Seng Bank Hong Kong Slam, with Judit Castillo and Andie Dikosavljevic contesting the women's singles final and Tama Shimabukuro meeting Hunter Johnson for the men's title.

newsItems.title: Asian Champs Medal Day
newsItems.excerpt: Tashkent's Olympic Town stages singles and doubles semifinals and finals at the ITTF-ATTU Asian Championships, with Harimoto, Kuai Man, Li Tianyang and Tomokazu Harimoto among those chasing individual gold after Japan's mixed doubles triumph.
